verdict.rationale: Embedded banking is a fair question for a fintech banking-API product. The evidence shows a different capability: Mercury's API operates the developer's own Mercury accounts (balances, payments, cards, invoices), and OAuth2 lets approved third-party apps integrate on behalf of existing Mercury users. Nothing documents provisioning bank accounts for the developer's own end customers under Mercury's partner-bank arrangement. The partner-bank disclosures describe Mercury's own licensing model, not a service offered to developers, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer embedded banking accounts to my customers without holding my own financial license
